citation_today.words: The holdings footer prints a date with a fixed 5:00p ET clock. It passes the date alone to PanelFooter, whose formatPanelTimestamp builds the time through create5pmETDate, so the clock is a convention and no time is read from the file or the pull. HoldingsTreemap.tsx line 620 and AllocationBars.tsx line 305 carry the same footer pattern. The workspace portal holds the adapter at adapt.ts lines 1164, 1229 and 1233.

consequence.words: Not decided, since the answer is UNDETERMINED. The date stands until the offset is measured. The 5:00p ET clock is a constructed convention and would have to go under a PULL_DATE answer whatever the date source is.
